pair from source `d2e14d96af5942409c9a315dc8594fcc164a702a`.
**Native correctness, unrestricted heterogeneous-use readiness and package closure

Authoring files are `main-r5.tex`, `release-identities-r5.tex`,

science, implementation and disclosure reviews govern local PDF delivery; their
identities accompany the public publication manifest. Earlier revisions remain

The native binary sidecars retain tested mint-time descriptions. Only WEPPpy's
two JSON sidecars receive the separately reviewed five-key descriptive transition;
every execution-relevant value and binary byte remains identical to tested bytes.
The retained bridge attributes earlier tests to their original JSON snapshots.
